howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at the start and releases when the text arrives as asked. A timer to the seller, set past the due date, pays finished work if the buyer goes quiet, and means a buyer who disagrees must settle before it runs out. Before paying, agree the length, the tone and the rounds of changes.
